name: 0061 - RFC 0065 Slice 4 visual-regression hard gate + a11y + Lighthouse

jobs.title: Flip the visual-regression compare to a hard gate, add a11y checks + Lighthouse, regenerate baselines, ratify D047
jobs.objective: Land RFC 0065 Slice 4. STEP 1 (baselines first): on this canonical render environment (this host's Chromium build), regenerate the three committed PNG baselines under tests/visual_baselines/ (1440x900, 1024x768, 960x720) via the existing `--update-visual-baselines` path so they capture the POST-Slice-2/3 appearance (the current committed PNGs are the pre-redesign Slice 0 capture and WILL mismatch). Review the regenerated PNGs as an explained diff (note in the patch summary what visibly changed and why — the Slice 2 reflow + Slice 3 states), with the 3D VtkRemoteView region masked out as today. STEP 2: in tests/test_web_browser.py, flip the visual compare in the browser-acceptance profile from advisory to a HARD FAILURE when the per-viewport pixel-difference exceeds a DOCUMENTED tolerance (choose a tolerance that absorbs anti-aliasing/font-hinting jitter without hiding real regressions; keep the VTK mask; keep missing Playwright/Chromium a SKIP in the optional smoke and a HARD FAILURE in the acceptance profile). STEP 3: add acceptance-profile a11y checks — deterministic focus order across the shell, a visible focus ring sourced from the Slice 1 --state-focus-ring token on the focused control, a minimum hit-target size on interactive controls, and contrast satisfying CONTRAST_MANIFEST (the manifest contrast test stays a mandatory pytest gate needing no browser; extend CONTRAST_MANIFEST additively in theme.py only if a new a11y pair is needed). Apply only MINIMAL token-sourced code fixes if an a11y assertion legitimately fails (e.g. a control missing the focus ring or below hit-target min). STEP 4: record a Lighthouse Best-Practices >= 90 result (optional, tool-dependent; not a mandatory pytest gate). STEP 5: retain ALL existing behavioural acceptance checks (nonblank-3D before AND after a control mutation; Share-URL reload round-trip with the same Hull.hash(); STL bytes via POST /api/stl?part=hull; console/page-error/network cleanliness) — they must still pass; add no new network allowlist entry without the documented URL pattern, expected status, rationale, and removal-condition note. STEP 6 (docs — Slice 4 is the ONLY slice that touches these): update docs/WEB_VERIFICATION.md with the baseline-update procedure (canonical OS + Chromium build, the regeneration command, the reviewed-diff expectation) and the mandatory-vs-optional gate table; update docs/USER_GUIDE.md to describe the polish behaviour and the new verification gate; ratify DECISION_LOG row D047 (flip status proposed -> accepted, recording the chosen tolerance + in-repo PNG storage); add a CHANGELOG.md entry. Claim line byte-stable (touch no CHIP_*/caption, recolour no chip); RFC 0032 boundary intact (no new route/claim_state/Readiness/accepted_uses literal, no analysis surface). Preserve the Slice 2/3 region/status/collapse/first-viewport contract and the empty/loading/error hooks. See SLICE_4_DECISIONS.md D1-D8.

jobs.title: Review traceability to RFC 0065 Slice 4 decisions
jobs.objective: Review every workflow 0061 change for traceability to RFC 0065 section 5 and SLICE_4_DECISIONS.md (D1-D8). Confirm the baselines were regenerated on the canonical env (the PNG diff is explained, not unexplained churn) BEFORE the compare was flipped to hard; the visual compare is now a HARD FAILURE in the acceptance profile with a documented per-viewport tolerance and the VTK mask retained; the a11y checks (focus order, visible focus ring from the Slice 1 token, hit-target min, CONTRAST_MANIFEST) are present with the documented SKIP-vs-HARD posture; Lighthouse >= 90 is recorded (not a mandatory pytest gate); all retained behavioural checks remain; docs/WEB_VERIFICATION.md has the baseline-update procedure + the mandatory-vs-optional table; docs/USER_GUIDE.md is updated; DECISION_LOG D047 is ratified (proposed -> accepted). Flag scope creep: any new analysis surface/route/claim literal, any CHIP_*/caption change, any layout re-flow beyond minimal a11y fixes, or any CONTRAST_MANIFEST/theme change that is not additive.

jobs.title: Review claims and user-facing boundaries
jobs.objective: Review every workflow 0061 change for claim truthfulness. Confirm CHIP_SPECS/CHIP_LABELS/CHIP_CLASSES are byte-identical and no chip is recoloured; every persistent caption (resistance, high-angle GZ, CFD local/artifact, not-watertight-cfd_ready) is byte-identical; the regenerated screenshot baselines do not bake an unvalidated/raw result into a confident/validated/calibrated visual treatment (the masked 3D region aside, the captured chips/captions still read as raw/advisory where they must); the docs updates (WEB_VERIFICATION.md, USER_GUIDE.md) describe only polish + the verification gate and introduce NO new capability/availability/claim language and no RFC 0033 section 8 no-go term; DECISION_LOG D047 ratification records the harness shape only and asserts no analysis claim; no new claim_state/Readiness/accepted_uses literal and no new REST route (RFC 0032 boundary); the RFC 0032 web-analysis boundary text in the docs is unchanged.

jobs.title: Review tests, determinism, and the gate posture
jobs.objective: Review workflow 0061 for gate correctness and determinism. Confirm: the regenerated baselines (1440x900/1024x768/960x720) match the current post-redesign render so the HARD compare passes within the documented tolerance, and the compare actually fails on an injected over-tolerance diff (not a no-op); the VTK region is masked; missing Playwright/Chromium SKIPs the optional smoke and HARD-FAILS the acceptance profile; the a11y checks (focus order, visible ring, hit-target, contrast) are deterministic and assert real conditions; the CONTRAST_MANIFEST pytest gate passes in both palettes; the retained behavioural checks (nonblank-3D before/after, Share reload round-trip, STL via POST /api/stl?part=hull, console/network cleanliness) still pass; the Lighthouse result is recorded (not a hard pytest gate); the full repo suite minus env-gated smoke is green except the known pre-existing NB-2 services-import-boundary failure (out of scope); and git diff --check passes. If the canonical browser-acceptance run cannot execute in this lane, run a SHORT targeted verification, publish the verdict while the lease is warm, THEN run the longer suite (per the operator hazard about lease expiry on long foreground commands).

jobs.title: Build findings ledger
jobs.objective: Deduplicate the three review findings into must-fix remediation items and non-blocking successor items (pointing at a follow-up workflow where appropriate) without inventing new design scope. Cross-check each finding against SLICE_4_DECISIONS.md. Treat the known NB-2 services-import-boundary failure as a non-blocking successor (hygiene follow-up), not a Slice 4 must-fix. Flag any baseline PNG that was committed without an explained diff as a must-fix.

jobs.title: Remediate review findings
jobs.objective: Fix the must-fix findings from the ledger, update CHANGELOG.md and this workflow's OPERATOR_REPORT.md, and preserve all SLICE_4_DECISIONS.md decisions and the no-claims boundaries (byte-stable claim line; regenerated baselines as an explained diff; the hard gate + documented tolerance + VTK mask; the SKIP-vs-HARD a11y posture; the retained behavioural checks; D047 ratified; WEB_VERIFICATION.md + USER_GUIDE.md describing only polish + the gate). Re-run the CONTRAST_MANIFEST gate, the desktop rendered-bbox tests, the visual-baseline compare on the canonical env, and the full repo suite minus the env-gated smoke before publishing.

jobs.title: Final review workflow 0061 — RFC 0065 completion
jobs.objective: Final-review workflow 0061 for accepted Slice 4 scope, decision fidelity (D1-D8), and no-claims boundaries — and confirm RFC 0065 is COMPLETE.
